node.title: Re^3: dealing with cyrillic characters
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The AM already provided a link to [http://blogs.perl.org/users/leon_timmermans/2015/08/fileslurp-is-broken-and-wrong.html|File::Slurp is broken and wrong]. I suggest you use this instead (as just discussed [id://1217182|here]):

my $string = do { open my $fh, '<:raw:encoding(UTF-8)', $file or die "$file: $!"; local $/; <$fh> };
